say:1:1130958001:1.text: It would be a shame if it was all a lie.
say:1:1130958001:1.source_cn: 如果说完全没有，那肯定是骗人的。

say:2:1130958002:1.text: Just imagine sunlight penetrating deep into the ruins, illuminating countless shimmering treasures... with any luck, we'll find artifacts left by the Dusk Lord Himself!
say:2:1130958002:1.source_cn: 试想一下，阳光深入洞穴，照亮了无数的金银财宝……运气好...

say:3:1130958003:1.text: And I get to witness them in all their glory! No need to look at old parchments with faded, barely recognizable designs!
say:3:1130958003:1.source_cn: 最重要的是，我可以目睹它们最美、最贴近历史的模样！不用...

say:4:1130958004:1.text: It's an archaeologist's dream! I'm getting chills just thinking about it!
say:4:1130958004:1.source_cn: ——这简直是所有考古学家的梦想！光是想想，我就激动得浑...
